videos.title: Buttonwillow Circuit ND Miata 2:10.3
videos.description:
Second time at this track but first ever track day with upgraded tires and coilovers:
Continental Extremecontact Force 245/40 r17
Tecna coilovers w/ sport springs

6.5 seconds faster than last time on old setup!

Definitely need to swap from autocross pads (Ferodo ds2500) to track pads next. They were fading really badly after just 2 or 3 laps and gave me no confidence to brake hard.

videos.title: Formula SAE Electric GR25 Battery Module Manufacturing Time Lapse
videos.description: Manufacturing of one of five battery modules for Gaucho Racing's GR25 electric race car. Each module is 3p28s of Molicel P45B 2170 cells. They are potted onto a CNC milled aluminum cold plate with aluminum oxide ceramic spacers under each cell.  Aluminum nitride heat fins are potted alongside the cells to reduce the cells’ axial thermal gradient.

videos.title: What is Generative Design?? ARE ROBOTS SUPERIOR THAN HUMANS!?
videos.description:
This is a brief overview of topology optimization and generative design! Thank you to Claire, Kevin, and Henry for participating as interviewees! I had a lot of fun working on this project :)

If people are actually interested in this project and want to learn more or watch more poorly made content, I'd love to hear some feedback or give this video a like!

Thank you!!

Some references I used:

Generative Design: The Road to Production by PhilKeane. Engineering.com. (n.d.). https://www.engineering.com/story/generative-design-the-road-to-production.

Hendrixson, S. (2019, August 28). Video: Topology Optimization versus Generative Design. Additive Manufacturing. https://www.additivemanufacturing.media/articles/video-topology-optimization-versus-generative-design.

https://omnexus.specialchem.com/polymer-properties/properties/strength-at-yield-tensile.
Topology Optimization is not Generative Design. Fusion 360 Blog. (2020, June 11). https://www.autodesk.com/products/fusion-360/blog/topology-optimization-is-not-generative-design/.

Tyrrell, M., & Richardson, M. (2020, January 20). Building with a new generation. Aerospace Manufacturing. https://www.aero-mag.com/airbus-autodesk-generative-design-aircraft-components-200120/. 

What is Generative Design: Tools & Software. Autodesk. (n.d.). https://www.autodesk.com/solutions/generative-design.
